description: This Java class 'ClientIdentifierCommand' defines an immutable command object used for creating or updating client identifier details within the Fineract system. It includes fields for document type ID, document key, description, and status, along with methods for validation before create or update operations.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierCommand
classes.description: Immutable command for creating or updating details of a client identifier.

methods.name: getDocumentTypeId
methods.description: Returns the document type ID associated with the client identifier.

methods.name: getDocumentKey
methods.description: Returns the document key associated with the client identifier.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the client identifier.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the command data before creating a new client identifier, ensuring required fields are present and valid.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the command data before updating an existing client identifier, ensuring the data is appropriate for update operations.
